title: Building an geopolitical war strategy game, looking for collaborators
author: DjuricX
selftext:
I want to build a geopolitical war strategy game: real countries, alliances, player-driven economies, military buildup, base building, territory control, and actual politics layered in.

I'm building most of it with Codex and Claude, and I'm looking for individuals who think the same way I do about this, people who are into vibe coding, want to build ambitious systems-heavy projects with AI, and actually want to see this through rather than just talk about it. Not a professional dev myself, but I think this is exactly the kind of project that's possible now if you've got the right people around you.

**Core idea:**

* Persistent world map, territories controlled by players/alliances
* Base building + resource management (treasury, power, fuel, ammo)
* Military tech progression, units, logistics
* Alliances, diplomacy, and a politics layer (elected leaders, policy effects)
* Live operations (attack/defend/supply), notifications, world events

**Looking for:**

* People also using Codex/Claude (or similar) who want to collaborate long-term
* Backend/multiplayer state sync help
* Frontend folks who like building game UI
* Anyone who's vibe-coded a multiplayer or persistent-world project before

If this sounds like your kind of project, drop a comment or DM. Would rather find a few serious people than a big crowd.
